data.name: Gun Glade
data.detailed_description:
GUN GLADE (this is an ALPHA 2.2 version of the game).

Be the first to survive 3 matches of this Round-Based Battle Royale.
8 Teams. 3 Lives. 1 Win.

This is PlayerIGN's battle royale (not affiliated w/ media IGN nor PUBG).
BR. But Another Around.
---
I am a solo developer, that spent 1 yr learning programming, netcode, and Unreal Engine to pursue game development.
Choosing to make a Mass Multiplayer-FPS as a first project is REALLY CHALLENGING, because of the sheer amount of work and understanding that goes into multiplayer games.

But I do it anyways.

The build is still incomplete and buggy, but I need to know if the game mode is good to continue it.

Some features I am currently working on so far are buildings, destruction, and final third-person models & animations.
---
This game begins with 8 teams of players spawning on the edge of the map with a shrinking-zone facing off against one another in classic Battle-Royale style fight to the death.

This cycle repeats continuously until the first team to accomplish this feat 3 times, in Tactical FPS action combat.
---
Good Luck. Player.
---
FEATURES:
• Wall Penetration, Limb Penetration, Flesh Penetration
• 12 Attachment-Types
• 7 Reload-Types + Bolt-Catch System
• Leaning and Aiming Down Sights (ADS)
• Ping Wheel: Threat, Standard Ping / Loot Ping, Back Me Up, Rotating Here
• Guns: HK416 - AR, 590M - Shotgun, AWP - Sniper, KRISS Vector - SMG, MK14 EBR
• Anticheat: Fog of War - Smoke Grenades
• Grenade - Explosive w/ cooking function
• Grenade - Stun w/ decoy function
• Grenade - Smoke w/ changing color function
• Grenade - Fire w/ spread function
• Wrist-Watch - Map/Radar (for spotting objects through grass within a 15m radius) 
• Realistic Scopes (optimized "Picture-in-Picture" and "Scope Parallax")
• Weapon Loot Visualizers (Magazine Removed? Bolt Catch Locked? Bolt Required? Pump Required?)
• Item Throwing (Ammo, Weapons)
• Grenade Throwback (pick up grenades, and throw them back)
• Medic Pen (for self-heal and stab-healing teammates)
• Server List

data.short_description: Gun Glade, is my take on a new Round-Based Battle Royale format. Spawn into The Glade, loot unique weapons, and survive an ever-shrinking zone in classic last-man standing BR. The first team to win 3 rounds wins the entire game. Battle Royale. Another Round. Kill. Die. Repeat. Solo Dev. Alpha 2.2.
